verdicts: Fair test: meta-training does something (MIX holds more structure than FRESH on rungs 1-3, paired range above 0); noise is unlearnable (no arm's median held bits on noise above tol; overfitting can only push it below 0); the ladder is real (FRESH holds less on rung 5 than rung 1 in >= 90% of worlds)
Training on the ability to increase held structure beats training on error, at equal task diversity, on rungs NEVER trained on: CLIMB_U minus MIX in held bits on rungs 4-5, paired range above 0
Self-chosen rungs add to it: CLIMB minus CLIMB_U in held bits on rungs 4-5, paired range above 0

THE TRAP: complexity measured without reference to truth memorises noise: RAWCX fits noise tasks' training points better than MIX (range above 0) AND holds less real structure on rungs 1-3 (range below 0)
U3 reading: training on one fixed goal is single-minded: GOAL holds less structure than MIX on the rungs other than its goal rung (1, 3, 4, 5), range below 0
SKEPTIC BAR: the held-structure objective does not buy depth by absorbing noise: CLIMB_U's held bits on noise tasks are not below MIX's by more than tol (lower end of the range >= -tol)
